currentParagraphText: “You are aware that we also can’t simply give up the Truesoul, correct? We already invested far too much to walk away with nothing,” the Lodestar Matron tried, seemingly unable to comprehend why Jake was being so stubborn.

finalResult.nextParagraphText: “I’m pretty sure that’s called the sunk cost fallacy. It’s a fallacy for a reason. Sometimes, you need to know when to cut your losses. This is one such time,” Jake said in a calm voice.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “No idea, but I’m fairly confident he wouldn’t disagree with whatever choice I make today. Contrary to you guys, he respects when something is not his choice to make,” Jake spoke, taking a not-so-subtle dig at not just the god but the entire Holy Church.
